we have been able to show how the Eco-semiotic theory can be applied to the study of visual discourse in the emerging communication system.

The main takeaway from our work is that

the use of icons is not a new phenomenon in the mobile phone industry and that the icons used in the mobile phone are not new signs but familiar resources appropriated and sprayed to have new semantic values.

the use of mobile phone visual codes is a form of semiotics that is not only a new phenomenon but also a familiar phenomenon in the sense that it is a re-interpretation of some familiar codes from the natural environment.
the design of mobile phone visual communication should not only be limited to the primary level of meaning but also to the secondary level.
